Banking Management System (Socket-based) | C, Socket Programming, Pthreads, File Systems Oct 2025
Designed and implemented a multi-client banking system using C and TCP sockets with a centralized server and •
interactive clients.
Supported role-based access control for Customer, Employee, Manager, and Admin with distinct operations and •
permissions.
Implemented concurrent client handling using POSIX threads and ensured data consistency with advisory file locking •
(flock).
Built session management to enforce single active login per user and prevent concurrent session conflicts. •
Maintained persistent storage using structured text files for customers, employees, transactions, loans, and feedback. •
Logged all financial transactions with timestamps and implemented core banking operations such as deposit, withdrawal,

and fund transfer.
Smoking Status Classification | Python, Scikit-learn, SVM, Neural Networks Nov 2025
Built a supervised machine learning model to predict smoking status using health-related features. •
Applied Logistic Regression, SVM (RBF), and MLP Neural Networks for binary classification. •
Tuned hyperparameters using Optuna to maximize cross-validation accuracy. •
Evaluated models using confusion matrix, precision, recall, and F1-score to handle class imbalance. •
Academia Course Management System | Spring Boot, React, MySQL, JWT, JPA Nov 2025
Developed a full-stack academic course management system using Spring Boot backend and React frontend. •
Implemented secure authentication and authorization using Spring Security with JWT-based access control. •
Designed RESTful APIs for course browsing, enrollment, and prerequisite validation using Spring Data JPA and

Hibernate.
Integrated MySQL for persistent storage of courses, students, enrollments, and grades with proper entity relationships. •
Built a responsive React UI with role-based views, client-side routing, and API integration using Axios. •
Documented APIs using SpringDoc OpenAPI (Swagger) and ensured clean layered architecture with DTOs and •
MapStruct.
